title: Ketamine for Depression: Complete Guide to Treatment Options
description: IV ketamine, Spravato (esketamine), at-home ketamine: how they work, who qualifies, costs, risks, and how to find legitimate treatment.

content.text: Ketamine represents the first truly new mechanism for depression treatment in decades. Unlike SSRIs that take weeks, ketamine can work within hours. Here's everything you need to know about treatment options.
Ketamine works differently from traditional antidepressants:

items: Effects begin within hours, not weeks
May 'reset' neural circuits involved in depression
Nasal spray, given in certified clinics
Must stay at clinic 2 hours per session

content.text: At-home ketamine has less rigorous evidence than clinical ketamine, and some telehealth companies have faced scrutiny for lax screening. If possible, start with Spravato or IV ketamine in a clinical setting.

items: Severe depression with acute suicidal ideation
Depression not responding to therapy + medication
Those who can't tolerate traditional antidepressants

content.text: Ketamine is a legitimate breakthrough for treatment-resistant depression, with rapid effects that traditional antidepressants can't match. If you've tried multiple medications without success, it's worth discussing with your psychiatrist.
